section_summary.extract_value: This section details the factor structure analysis of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). The initial CFA on the full sample (N=591) did not fit well, leading to a split into two subsamples (n=296 and n=295) for PCA and subsequent CFA. The analysis ultimately confirmed an adequate two-factor solution for the BAS, labeled 'General Body Appreciation' and 'Body Image Investment', which was found to be invariant across Malay (n=315) and Chinese (n=276) ethnic groups.
